Paper Name: Novel optimization technique of isolated microgrid with hydrogen energy storage
NOTES: This paper focuses on optimization technique comparison (NSGA-II vs MOFPA) for an isolated IEEE 15-bus microgrid. It does NOT report standard economic parameters (capital costs, O&M costs, replacement costs, component lifetimes, discount rate, project lifetime, emission factors, etc.). The system is a case study with peak load 3.5 MW. Configuration 3 (hybrid with H2 storage) is the primary complete system. Load is given as peak power (3.5 MW) with daily profiles in figures — no explicit annual energy demand in MWh is stated; daily load profile data is in supplementary files. No LCOE/COE/LPSP values reported. No diesel cost coefficients (f0, f1) explicitly given. Diesel generator fuel cost function is CF = ai + bi*PG + ci*PG^2 but coefficients a,b,c not specified. No economic or cost parameters for components reported. Wind turbine: Polaris 100kW, 10 units. PV: 3500kW max (Config 3). H2 tank: 0-300kg. H2_LHV = 33.33 kWh/kg. eta_FC = 38.36%, eta_elyz = 34.35%. No inverter efficiency reported. No component lifetimes, capital costs, O&M costs, replacement costs, or economic parameters reported. This is a power systems optimization paper, not a techno-economic design paper.
